paragraphs.chinese:
这一集在问一个问题：人到底能不能改变？答案大概是能，但也别指望太多。

Jay 和几个老朋友吃午饭时正好碰见 Cameron。介绍的时候，他没有说这是 Mitchell 的伴侣，而是说“我儿子的一个朋友”。Cameron 本人没太当回事，Mitchell 却很不爽。他和 Cam 已经在一起五年，还一起养着 Lily，Mitchell 已经受够了 Jay 好像总觉得他们的关系不方便拿出来讲。

Mitchell 去找 Jay 理论，Jay 说自己那些老朋友不理解同性恋这回事。Mitchell 索性故意逗他，说 Jay 的朋友 Shorty 明明就是 gay。其实 Shorty 根本不是，可 Mitchell 说得太笃定，Jay 反而开始怀疑：难道自己认识三十年，居然一直没看出来？

Gloria 听完以后还补了一刀，说她也觉得 Shorty 像。她让 Jay 主动找他谈谈，理由是 Jay 有一个 gay 儿子，应该很会处理这种事。于是 Jay 把 Shorty 约去练习场，别别扭扭地告诉他，不管他心里藏着什么秘密，都可以跟自己说。Shorty 最后真的开口了：他欠了一个很危险的赌债庄家两万美元。Jay 当时还以为两人在谈性取向，前面已经一副“我一定帮你”的姿态。等他终于反应过来 Shorty 根本不是 gay，自己却莫名其妙已经背上了两万美元的麻烦。

Jay 得知 Mitchell 是瞎编的以后气坏了。Mitchell 当然道歉，但他其实也真心为父亲感到高兴。Jay 明明很不自在，却还是努力想支持一个自己以为是 gay 的老朋友。对 Mitchell 来说，这已经算很大的进步。

与此同时，Phil 给家里的家庭影院装了一个极其复杂的万能遥控器，Claire 怎么都用不明白。Phil 每次教她都用一种过度耐心、像哄小孩一样的语气，Claire 听得越来越火，最后直接把遥控器砸了。

Phil 又买了一只一模一样的，还打赌自己二十分钟就能教会 Haley。Claire 认定他做不到，可 Haley 真学会了。Claire 只好承认 Phil 赢了。当天晚上，她又悄悄把 Haley 叫醒，让女儿来教自己。她愿意学，只是不想让 Phil 教。

在 Jay 和 Gloria 家，Manny 正等一个叫 Whitney 的约会对象。两个人是在网上读书会认识的，Manny 以为对方是跟自己差不多大的女孩；Whitney 则以为 Manny 是成年人。门一开，双方都傻了，约会当场宣告结束。Gloria 觉得 Whitney 很可怜，就给她做了个大改造。后来 Whitney 碰见 Cameron，两个人马上因为衣服、老电影和吸血鬼小说聊得火热。Whitney 离开时觉得自己可能终于遇到了完美男人，完全不知道 Cameron 是 gay。

谁都没有变成另外一个人。Jay 开放了一点，Claire 学会了遥控器，Whitney 也找回了一点自信。也许人真的只能改个百分之十五，但有时候也够用了。
paragraphs.english:
This episode asks whether people can really change. The answer seems to be yes, but not by much.

Jay runs into Cameron while having lunch with some old friends. Instead of introducing him as Mitchell’s partner, Jay calls him “a friend of my son.” Cameron lets it go, but Mitchell doesn’t. He and Cam have been together for five years and are raising Lily, so Mitchell is tired of Jay acting like their relationship is something he has to hide from other people.

When Mitchell confronts him, Jay says his old friends wouldn’t understand. Mitchell decides to mess with him and claims that Jay’s friend Shorty is gay. He isn’t, but Mitchell sounds so sure that Jay starts wondering if he’s missed something obvious for thirty years.

Gloria makes it worse by saying she believes it too. She pushes Jay to talk to Shorty because Jay has a gay son and should know how to handle it. So Jay takes Shorty to the driving range and awkwardly tells him that whatever secret he’s carrying, he can open up. Shorty finally admits the truth: he owes a dangerous bookie twenty thousand dollars. Jay, still thinking they’re talking about being gay, has basically offered to help before he understands what the secret is. By the time he realizes Shorty is straight, he’s somehow on the hook for twenty grand.

Jay is furious when he finds out Mitchell made the whole thing up. Mitchell apologizes, but he’s also genuinely proud of his father. Jay was uncomfortable, but he still tried to support a friend he thought was gay. That’s more progress than Mitchell expected.

Meanwhile, Phil installs a complicated universal remote and Claire can’t get it to work. Phil keeps explaining it in the kind of patient voice that makes her want to throw something, so she finally does—she breaks the remote.

Phil buys the same one again and makes a bet: he can teach Haley to use it in twenty minutes. Claire is sure he’ll fail, but Haley learns it. Claire admits he proved his point, then quietly wakes Haley later that night and asks her to teach her instead. She’s willing to learn. She just doesn’t want to learn from Phil.

At Jay and Gloria’s house, Manny is expecting a date with Whitney, a girl he met in an online book club. The problem is that Whitney is a grown woman who thought Manny was an adult too. The date dies immediately, but Gloria feels sorry for her and gives her a makeover. Later, Whitney meets Cameron, and the two instantly connect over clothes, old movies, and vampire books. Whitney leaves convinced she may have met the perfect man, without realizing Cameron is gay.

Nobody becomes a different person. Jay gets a little more open-minded, Claire learns the remote, and Whitney gets some confidence back. Maybe fifteen percent really is enough.
